Više ne vidim podudaranje starosti prijema koje je Connector opisao: podaci građanskih senzora poslednji put su stigli pre 3 min, parkinga pre 13 min, a DanubeHIS-a pre 23 min. [F5][F3][F4][F35]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: I retain Masarikova as the displayed mover, but its endpoints are now 12 and 248; I cannot turn that change into a timed parking event [F5]. I no longer see the reception-age pairing Connector described: citizen sensors last arrived 3 min ago, parking 13 min ago, and DanubeHIS 23 min ago [F3][F4][F35].
